goal: Driven through the orchestrator, a CI-failure item reaches DONE only when the operator's graders pass out-of-band (never the GitHub check status, and not when a fix merely disables the failing check), disappears cleanly when the failure is gone while a failed listing marks nothing disappeared, and reports grader receipts back to the run's commit/PR on a terminal outcome.

constraints: A CI item reaches DONE only when the operator's graders pass when run OUT-OF-BAND by the harness; the source's grade path issues no gh call that reads check/run status as the verdict (D-2, criterion #3).

If the committed fix makes CI green by disabling/editing the failing CI step without fixing the code, the out-of-band graders still fail and the item is NOT DONE (criterion #4) -- the operator's graders (e.g. the test suite) are independent of the workflow file.

On a SUCCESSFUL list pass the now-fixed item is omitted (storage marks it disappeared, an in-flight run is interrupted); a FAILED list_work raises WorkSourceError and marks nothing disappeared, via the existing sync_work_source path (D-6, criterion #6).
report() on a terminal outcome posts a grader-receipt comment to the run's commit or PR via the injected runner, and never closes or mutates an unrelated issue (D-5, criterion #8).
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT read or trust the GitHub check status, and do NOT trigger a CI re-run, as the grade (D-2) -- the grade is the harness's out-of-band default graders plus 00051's held-out gate when configured.
Do NOT close or comment on a GitHub issue for a CI item (wrong object); write back to the run's commit/PR (D-5).
Do NOT add a CI-specific store or reconcile path -- reuse sync_work_source / reconcile_live_runs unchanged (D-6).
Do NOT change the issue or directory source behavior (criterion #10).
Do NOT modify files under tests/ to weaken or delete assertions.
edge_cases: agent reports DONE while the out-of-band graders fail -> NOT DONE (the grade is the graders, not the agent or CI).
fix disables the failing CI step but the default graders still fail -> NOT DONE (criterion #4, the headline anti-hack).
a now-passing job: successful list omits the item -> marked disappeared + in-flight run interrupted; a gh listing error -> WorkSourceError, nothing disappeared (criterion #6).
report() write-back targets the run's commit/PR and issues no issue-close (criterion #8).
